title: Shinonome Ena — Through Pain And Misery〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: On This Blank Canvas, I Paint

rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I made everyone worry again...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's like all that time I was gone has come back to haunt me.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Everyone else seems to know exactly how to draw what they want to draw...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: While I'm so far behind that I'm struggling to do even the most basic things...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: My mind's telling me to just keep drawing and doing whatever I can to get better.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But my body can't handle it...
Every time I go, I start shaking because I'm so scared of going to that class.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I can't do what the others can do and I know I'm never going to receive positive criticism. More than anything, I can't forgive myself for letting this all happen...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I keep asking myself, “Why did I run away that time...?”

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't think you were running away from anything, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It may be true that drawing illustrations for N25 won't necessarily give you opportunities to learn anything new or improve your skills.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But in my opinion, your art has improved compared to when we first met. It's clear that you're always looking for the best way to illustrate the music Mafuyu and I make.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I've recently been catching myself thinking just how much I like what you draw, Ena. You have this way of conveying so many different feelings all at once.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I remember being confused by your old illustrations in terms of what you were trying to express because of how you used odd colors and bent lines.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm still confused sometimes, but I understand your art better than before.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But if you really felt like running away, I doubt you would've drawn all these things.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I feel a little better thanks to them...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Knowing that I have their support is pretty big, huh?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I mean, the last time I was pushed into a corner...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Whoa, this one's from forever ago! You know, I never really get tired of seeing this girl and her floral hairpiece.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Right. The girl's body is turned the other way, but the background and flowers on her hair piece make you think about what sort of expression she may have.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <This was from when we made that song that made very different impressions on each person that listened to it.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That was why I wanted you to draw something that reflected that and also had the same effect. In the end, it matched perfectly with the song.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But I remember that I took too long designing the whole thing and made us upload later than usual.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <No, this was definitely worth the time. There's also...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes... I thought that I should actually tell you.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That your artwork isn't just an accessory.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I was so happy that time...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I have to keep trying...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I want to learn how to really illustrate the songs Kanade and Mafuyu make for us.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (For the sake of our videos too since Mizuki needs my illustrations to put them together...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Just keep drawing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'm probably not gonna hear anything positive next time from Mr. Yukihira...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I know that running away won't lead me anywhere good now.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So I...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: I'm saying that you'll keep feeling this pain if you choose to continue drawing...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: You won't always be able to produce works that satisfy you. Can you deal with that pain moving forward?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm done running...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But this won't stop happening as long as I keep drawing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Haha. This is gonna hurt, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The others believe in me.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (More importantly, I want to keep drawing.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll pick this back up tomorrow.
